prompt.text:
Build the super admin message visibility feature for WorkforceAP.

## Objective
Super admins need to see ALL counselor-member communications across the platform with escalation alerts for missed/delayed responses.

## Current State
- Messaging is counselor notes stored in CounselorNote table (memberId, authorId, content)
- Roles: member, admin, case_manager (no super_admin yet)
- No admin-level message dashboard exists

## What to Build

### 1. Database: Add MessageThread and SLA alert tracking

Add to schema.prisma:
```prisma
model MessageThread {
  id               String    @id @default(uuid())
  memberId         String    @map("member_id")
  counselorId      String?   @map("counselor_id")
  lastMessageAt    DateTime  @map("last_message_at")
  lastMessageBy    String    @map("last_message_by") // "member" | "counselor"
  counselorRepliedAt DateTime? @map("counselor_replied_at")
  alertLevel       String    @default("none") @map("alert_level") // none | warning | critical
  alertAckedAt     DateTime? @map("alert_acked_at")
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  member    User @relation("ThreadMember", fields: [memberId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  counselor User? @relation("ThreadCounselor", fields: [counselorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([memberId])
  @@index([alertLevel])
  @@index([lastMessageAt])
  @@map("message_threads")
}
```

Also add super_admin to roles via a migration that inserts into the roles table.

### 2. Admin Messages Dashboard: /admin/messages

A new page under the existing admin layout showing ALL message threads across the platform.

**Layout:**
- Left: Filter sidebar (Date range, Alert status: All/Warning/Critical, Counselor filter, Member search)
- Center: Thread list, sorted by most recent message desc
- Each thread card shows:
  - Member name + enrollment status
  - Assigned counselor name (or "Unassigned")
  - Last message preview (first 100 chars)
  - Time since last message (relative: "2h ago", "3 days ago")
  - Alert badge: yellow WARNING (>48h no counselor reply), red CRITICAL (>72h)
  - Unread indicator

**Thread detail panel (right side or modal):**
- Full message history for that member (all CounselorNotes)
- Timestamps, author names
- "Acknowledge Alert" button (clears the alert for this thread)

### 3. API Routes

```
GET /api/admin/messages/threads
  - Query: page, limit, alertLevel, counselorId, memberId, search
  - Auth: requireAdmin() with super_admin check
  - Returns: paginated threads with member + counselor info

GET /api/admin/messages/thread/[memberId]  
  - Returns: all CounselorNotes for a member, newest first

POST /api/admin/messages/alert/acknowledge
  - Body: { memberId }
  - Marks alertAckedAt = now() on the thread

GET /api/admin/messages/stats
  - Returns: { total, warnings, critical, avgResponseHours }
```

### 4. Alert Badge in Admin Nav

Add a red badge to the "Messages" link in the admin sidebar nav (app/admin/layout.tsx) showing count of critical + warning threads. Fetch count server-side on layout render.

### 5. Cron: Update Alert Levels

Add to the existing cron pattern — a function that runs on a schedule to scan CounselorNotes and update alert levels on MessageThread records:
- Last note was by member + more than 48h ago = "warning"
- Last note was by member + more than 72h ago = "critical"
- Last note was by counselor = "none"

Hook this into the existing /api/cron pattern in the codebase.

### 6. Access Control

- Route must check admin role (use existing requireAdmin pattern)
- Add super_admin concept: admins with role 'admin' can see messages
- Read-only — no ability to send messages from admin view

## ANTI-SLOP RULES (MANDATORY)
- NO buzzwords: revolutionary, seamless, world-class, cutting-edge, innovative
- NO generic copy: "Empowering counselors to...", "Unlock visibility..."
- UI labels must be direct: "All Messages", "Warning (48h+)", "Critical (72h+)", "Acknowledge"
- Timestamps must be specific and relative, not vague

## File Structure
```
app/admin/messages/
├── page.tsx
├── components/
│   ├── MessageThreadList.tsx
│   ├── MessageThreadCard.tsx
│   ├── MessageThreadDetail.tsx
│   └── AlertBadge.tsx
app/api/admin/messages/
├── threads/route.ts
├── thread/[memberId]/route.ts
├── alert/acknowledge/route.ts
└── stats/route.ts
prisma/migrations/[timestamp]_message_threads/
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- Admin navigates to /admin/messages → sees all member-counselor threads
- Threads with >48h no counselor reply show yellow WARNING badge
- Threads with >72h no counselor reply show red CRITICAL badge  
- Admin can click a thread to see full message history
- Admin can click "Acknowledge" to clear the alert
- Nav sidebar shows count of active alerts
- No regression to existing counselor note creation flow

Build this completely. Use existing patterns from the codebase (see app/admin/pipeline/page.tsx and app/admin/members/ for UI patterns, prisma/schema.prisma for DB patterns).
